explication: goldmark is a Go Markdown processing library: callers provide Markdown, the parser builds a source-aware AST, and a separate renderer produces HTML (or another format). Its AST also supports programmatic construction and semantic analysis. Built-in and custom extensions add syntax and rendering, including GFM-style tables, task lists, footnotes, and typographic transformations. The README documents the main parse/render workflow; some internal connections and unsampled extension implementations are therefore shown only where documented or excerpted.
